name: shadowiron
lore_descriptor: black as pitch, edges absorbing torchlight
first_pickup_chronicle: Shadowiron. Drains me a little every turn. Worth it for what it does to the dead. I am told the smiths who worked this metal did not live past forty. I am told they did good work.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.35, weight_mult 0.90, effective_against celestial+aberration (T4 specialty). The catch: drains 1 HP per turn equipped. cannot_be_blessed — necrotic alignment. Damages the player's angel allies. Tactical risk material. void_aligned flag enables Abaddon-side karma interactions.
